title.zh: 从社区原型到企业级生产规模化的 Choose → Prove → Sustain 闭环架构（THR1022）
title.en: Community-to-Production Agentic Scaling Architecture: Choose, Prove & Sustain (THR1022)

label.zh: 1. CHOOSE · 断裂工作流征集与四项测试筛选层（Broken-Workflow Intake & Four-Test Scorecard）
label.en: 1. CHOOSE · Broken-Workflow Intake & Four-Test Scorecard Triage

label.zh: 2. PROVE · 建前五问基线、回收率折算与四维价值引擎（Pre-Build Baseline & Recapture ROI Engine）
label.en: 2. PROVE · Pre-Build Value Baseline, Recapture Math & Four Value Drivers

label.zh: 3. SUSTAIN · 采纳飞轮、M365 消费限额与退役治理（Adoption Flywheel & M365 Admin Spend Control）
label.en: 3. SUSTAIN · Habit Flywheel, M365 Admin Spend Limits & Lifecycle Retirement

label.zh: 征集“断裂工作流”而非点子

detail.zh: 黑客松与立项停征泛化智能体创意，锁定耗时数周或跨多工具受阻的真实团队痛点
detail.en: Replace generic agent brainstorms with concrete workflows slowing or failing teams

label.zh: 四项测试计分卡与决策者共审

detail.zh: 联合业务决策者逐项核验：周频重复、锚定指标、人机交接提质、端到端零手工断尾
detail.en: Score Repetitive, Valuable, Handoff & End-to-End with decision makers in the room

label.zh: 组合配比与实名责任人绑定

detail.zh: 优选 3–5 个速赢与 1–2 个阶段门禁战略项目；恪守“无责任人、无基线则不立项”
detail.en: Fund 3–5 Quick Wins + 1–2 Strategic bets; enforce 'No owner, no baseline, no pilot'

label.zh: 开工前五问与量化基线锁定

detail.zh: 明确卡点环节、受影响角色、目标指标与期限、当前基线，以及扩缩或叫停评审人
detail.en: Lock bottleneck, role shift, target metric/date, baseline, and scale-or-stop reviewer

label.zh: 工时再投资回收率与归因折算

detail.zh: 破除“省 1,000 小时即赚 $72K”虚高口径，乘以有效再投资回收率（如 50%）与归因权重
detail.en: Discount raw hours saved (1,000h × $72) by recapture rate (e.g., 50% = $36K) & attribution

label.zh: 四维商业价值与风险质量护栏

detail.zh: 贯通效率、质量、营收与战略速度；用 Copilot Studio 追踪解决率与人工升级率
detail.en: Unite Efficiency, Quality, Revenue & Strategic speed; track Copilot Studio resolution

label.zh: 社区—采纳习惯双向飞轮

detail.zh: 创作者与先锋沉淀信任，推动认知转化为日常依赖习惯，再由倡导者反哺壮大社区
detail.en: Makers & champions build trust, turning awareness into daily habit and new advocates

label.zh: M365 管理中心消费限额与预警

detail.zh: 按人群、智能体与服务设定额度上限、告警与计费策略，透视高消耗团队与点数走势
detail.en: Set per-group/agent spending policies, limits & alerts; monitor credit consumption

label.zh: 高风险人机协同与退役止损门禁

detail.zh: 高危动作强制保留人工把关；预先约定调用跌破下限或成本超标时的主动下线条件
detail.en: Keep humans in high-risk actions; pre-set retirement triggers if usage drops or cost spikes

label.zh: 提报真实痛点
四测全过入池
立项锁定基线
测算真实净值
对齐四维指标
兑现价值促习惯
匹配点数预算
成本/低用度审计
倡导者反哺下一轮痛点
